location.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark
location.notes: Derived by combining named centres: Center for Eating Disorders (Odense University Hospital), Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital), Unit for Psychiatric Research (Aalborg University Hospital).

subject_id.notes: No unique participant identifiers reported for the 147-person cohort; only aggregate counts (77 AN, 70 HC) given.

sample_id.notes: No unique sample identifiers reported in the provided text.

subcohort.evidence_quote: we transplanted faecal microbiota from three randomly chosen AN-RS cases
subcohort.section: Results — Gut microbiota induces reduced weight gain
subcohort.notes: AN-RS subtype specified only for the 3 FMT donor cases; not reported for the general cohort at this top level (see samples).

control.evidence_quote: 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females
control.notes: Whole cohort comprises both Case (AN) and Study Control (HC) roles; single top-level value not applicable, see samples for per-donor assignment.

country.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark

body_site.evidence_quote: we performed shotgun metagenomics on faecal samples from 77 female AN cases

days_from_first_collection.notes: Cross-sectional design; no longitudinal collection timepoints reported for human samples.

westernized.notes: Not explicitly stated, though Danish cohort context implies westernized population.

age.evidence_quote: females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr with BMI of 10.3, 11.5 and 11.7
age.notes: Only individual ages available for the 6 human FMT donors (see samples); overall cohort ages reported only as aggregate in Supplementary Table 2 (not included in provided text).

age_group.notes: Donor ages (20-22 yr) would classify as Adult; not reported for full cohort in provided text.

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases
ancestry.notes: Explicitly stated only for AN cases; not explicitly repeated for HC controls though same recruitment context implied.

sex.evidence_quote: we decided to include only women in the present study

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Exclusion criterion covers 3 months prior, not strictly 'current use'; inferred that participants were antibiotic-free at time of sampling.

bmi.evidence_quote: BMI of 10.3, 11.5 and 11.7 kg m−2, respectively
bmi.notes: Only per-donor BMI values available (see samples); overall cohort BMI reported only in Supplementary Table 1/2, not in provided text.

disease.evidence_quote: 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females
disease.notes: Two disease states present in cohort (Anorexia Nervosa vs Healthy); single top-level value not applicable, see samples for per-donor assignment.

disease_details.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females
disease_details.notes: AN cases were further subdivided into AN-RS (restricting) and AN-BP (binge/purge) subtypes, and HC were described as healthy weight controls.

disease_response_orr.notes: Not applicable; study concerns anorexia nervosa, not oncology treatment response.

feces_phenotype.notes: Paper reports fecal microbiome/metagenomic and bacterial cell count analyses but does not report a discrete clinical 'feces phenotype' (e.g., stool consistency/occult blood) matching this field's scope.

fmt_id.notes: Only group-level labels (AN-T, HC-T) are given for FMT recipient mice; no individual participant-level FMT identifiers are reported for human donors.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: we transplanted faecal microbiota from three randomly chosen AN-RS cases ... and three age-matched HC participants to three independent litters of female germ-free (GF) mice
fmt_role.section: Results — Gut microbiota induces reduced weight gain and altered energy metabolism in mice
fmt_role.notes: Human AN and HC participants served as fecal donors; germ-free mice were the recipients (not part of the human subgroup schema).

hla.notes: HLA typing not mentioned in the paper.

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills
obgyn_birth_control.notes: Birth control pill use was permitted as an exception in control exclusion criteria, but actual usage status of participants is not reported.

smoker.evidence_quote: adjusting for confounders including age, smoking and multiple drug intake
smoker.section: Results — Associations between absolute bacterial abundance and bioclinical variables in AN
smoker.notes: Smoking is used as a covariate in statistical models but actual smoking status/percentages per participant or group are not reported in the provided text (likely in Supplementary Table 1/2, not included).

treatment.evidence_quote: deconfounding interferences of multiple medications (selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines, specified in Supplementary Table 2)
treatment.section: Results — Gut microbiota composition is altered in AN
treatment.notes: These medication classes were used by a subset of AN cases and were deconfounded as covariates; not stated to apply to HC group.

tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: Not applicable; study does not involve tumor staging.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: lower fasting serum concentrations of glucose and insulin, higher insulin sensitivity as estimated by homoeostatic model assessment for insulin resistance (HOMA-IR) and lower serum C-reactive protein
biomarker_name.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP, cholesterol, creatinine, sodium, potassium, albumin, ALT) are mentioned qualitatively as differing between groups, but exact numeric values/units are reported only in Supplementary Tables not included in provided text; leaving as not_reported to avoid fabricating paired name/value/unit lists.

biomarker_unit.notes: No explicit units given for biomarker values in provided text.

biomarker_value.notes: No explicit numeric biomarker values given in provided text (data likely in Supplementary Tables 1-2, not included).

disease_response_os.notes: Not applicable; not an oncology survival study.

feces_phenotype_value.notes: No matching discrete feces phenotype value reported.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not an oncology study; no residual tumor measurement reported.

target_condition.notes: Study focuses on AN in humans (cohort study) and a mouse model via FMT to mirror AN eating behaviour.

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_exclusion_period.notes: Same 3-month exclusion also applied to controls: 'antibiotics within the last 3 months.'

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA extraction from aliquots of faecal samples was performed following IHMS SOP P7 V2
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Faecal sample collection and DNA extraction
dna_extraction_kit.notes: A standard operating procedure (IHMS SOP P7 V2) is cited, but no specific commercial kit name is given.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer (Thermo Fisher)
sequencing_platform.notes: Maps to allowed value 'Ion Torrent Proton'; 16S rRNA mouse sequencing was separately done on Illumina MiSeq, but primary human metagenomics used Ion Proton.

host_species.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively, from a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females.
host_species.notes: Primary host species is human; the study also includes a mouse FMT model (Female germ-free Swiss Webster mice) as a secondary experimental system, but the schema enum only allows a single value and human is the primary/original host.

extraction_warnings: The full human cohort (77 AN, 70 HC) is only described with aggregate statistics in the main text; individual-level demographic data (age, BMI, exact ancestry) for most participants reside in Supplementary Tables 1 and 2, which were not included in the provided text.

Sample-level rows were only extractable for the 6 explicitly described FMT donor participants (3 AN-RS cases, 3 HC) mentioned in Methods — Animal experiments; these do not represent the entire cohort.
Ancestry ('Danish Caucasian') was explicitly stated only for AN cases in Methods; assumed comparable but not explicitly confirmed for HC donors.
No unique subject or sample identifiers were reported anywhere in the provided text (main text or supplementary notes/figures) for any participant, including the 6 FMT donors.
Body site details, ncbi_accession, and several other optional fields were not present in the provided text and may exist in unprovided supplementary tables or repository submission metadata.
Batch 1 returned granularity='subgroup_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 1 subgroups ['AN', 'HC'] differ from batch 0 []; kept batch 0.

This paper concerns anorexia nervosa gut microbiome research, not oncology; most oncology-specific schema fields (ORR, PFS, RECIST, OS, ECOG, tumor staging/size) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.

Many bioclinical variables (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP, creatinine, lipids) are mentioned qualitatively as differing between AN and HC groups, but exact numeric values are reported in Supplementary Tables 1-2, which were not included in the provided text; biomarker fields were left as not_reported to avoid fabrication.
Smoking status is used as a statistical covariate but specific smoking prevalence/status per group is not given in the provided text.

FMT role/donor information pertains to human AN/HC participants as donors and germ-free mice as recipients; mouse recipient subgroups (AN-T, HC-T) were not included as separate subgroups in the main granularity structure to keep alignment with human-participant-focused fields like disease_details.
No individual-level or sample-level rows (e.g., per-participant table) were available in the provided text/supplementary excerpts to support sample_level granularity.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('sample_level'); kept batch 0.
study_name and curator fields are not reported anywhere in the provided text; marked as not_reported.
pmid was inferred from the provided paper_id tag rather than explicit in-text citation, since PMIDs are not typically stated within the paper body.

host_species enum only allows a single value, but the study involves both human participants and a mouse FMT model; 'Human' chosen as the primary host, with mouse experiments noted separately in the notes field.
dna_extraction_kit is not explicitly named as a commercial kit; only an SOP reference (IHMS SOP P7 V2) is given, so marked not_reported.
tumor_size_residual_measurement is not applicable to this study (not an oncology paper).
